name: Ammunition of Slaying (Giant)

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: A Giant it hits makes a DC 17 Con save: 6d10 extra Piercing, half on a success; then it's ordinary.
text: Built to kill creatures of the Giant type, this ammunition forces any Giant it damages to attempt a Constitution saving throw against DC 17. On a failure the target suffers 6d10 extra Piercing damage; on a success, half that extra amount. After it has dealt this bonus damage once, the ammunition is ordinary.
